text:
Congratulations to the West Baltimore communities and leaders receiving $4.1 million in community grants tied to the Amtrak Frederick Douglass Tunnel Program. The Tunnel represents a historic federal investment in Baltimore, replacing the 153-year-old B&P Tunnel, rebuilding the West Baltimore MARC station, improving surrounding infrastructure and supporting thousands of jobs. Over ten years, the program will distribute $50 million in grants.

I worked with my colleagues in Congress to help secure this investment and press for protections, mitigation measures and community safeguards for the people who live along the project corridor. As construction moves forward, that Congressional oversight will continue so Baltimore receives the full protections and benefits of this federal investment.

I send my deepest appreciation to Principal Kimberly Hill at Mary Ann Winterling Elementary School for hosting the announcement. Kudos to Luigi Rosa, who leads the project for Amtrak, and to State Senator Antonio Hayes, Councilmen John Bullock and Jermaine Jones, and Comptroller Bill Henry for your work to ensure our constituents take advantage of this federal opportunity.

#FrederickDouglassTunnel #WestBaltimore #Baltimore #FederalInvestment #CommunityInvestment #Infrastructure #Amtrak #Maryland
